crime_description: Framing a renowned chef by secretly developing an allergic trigger in their signature dish. Interrogators should probe for connections to an insider, a vindictive motive, remote coordination, hidden assets, and an elaborate escape plan.

suspect.name: Silas Blackwood
suspect.fake_alibi: Silas claims he was miles away on his yacht, sailing under the moonlight with his fiancée.

secrets.value: Elena, the head librarian, who left the archival vault unlocked and disabled the sprinklers.
Silas wanted to destroy a specific set of genealogical records that proved he was not the rightful heir to his fortune.
was actively coordinating the crime from a secure burner phone
untraceable offshore account holding the illicit funds
